/*区间开始日*/ with qjVdate as( SELECT T.CASH_ID, T.OPEN_TYPE, T.OPEN_DATE_END, T.OPEN_VDATE, T.FINPROD_ID, T.RN FROM ( SELECT fci.CASH_ID AS CASH_ID, fop.OPEN_TYPE AS OPEN_TYPE, fop.OPEN_DATE_END AS OPEN_DATE_END, decode(FINOR.Calc_Rule,'01',fop.Open_Vdate,'02',fop.Open_Date_Str,'03',fop.Open_Date_End) AS OPEN_VDATE, fop.FINPROD_ID AS FINPROD_ID, RANK () OVER(PARTITION BY fci.CASH_ID,fop.OPEN_TYPE ORDER BY fop.OPEN_VDATE DESC) RN FROM FIN_CASH_INFO fci INNER JOIN FIN_OPEN_PLAN fop ON fci.CASH_ID = fop.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_OPEN_RULE FINOR ON FINOR.CASH_ID = fop.CASH_ID and FINOR.OPEN_TYPE = fop.OPEN_TYPE WHERE fci.FINPROD_TYPE = #{cashFinprodType} AND fci.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType1} AND fci.BRANCH = 0 AND fop.open_date_str <= to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')/*平台日-跑批日*/ ) T WHERE T.RN = 1 ), /*区间结束日*/ qjMdate as( SELECT fci.CASH_ID AS CASH_ID, fop.OPEN_TYPE AS OPEN_TYPE, max(fop.open_date_end) AS OPEN_MDATE, fop.FINPROD_ID AS FINPROD_ID FROM FIN_CASH_INFO fci INNER JOIN FIN_OPEN_PLAN fop ON fci.CASH_ID = fop.CASH_ID WHERE fci.FINPROD_TYPE = #{cashFinprodType} AND fci.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType1} AND fci.BRANCH = 0 AND fop.open_date_str > to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') /*平台日-跑批日*/ group by fci.CASH_ID, fop.OPEN_TYPE, fop.FINPROD_ID ) SELECT '开放计划' planType, fp.FINPROD_ID AS FINPROD_ID,/*金融产品代码*/ fp.PROFIT_TYPE AS profitType,/*收益类型*/ fp.VDATE AS VDATE,/*产品起息日*/ fp.CALENDAR_ID AS calendarId, /*交易日历*/ qjMdate.CASH_ID AS cashId, /*现金流代码*/ qjMdate.OPEN_TYPE AS openType, /*开放类型*/ nvl(qjVdate.OPEN_VDATE,fp.VDATE) AS openVdate, /*开放计划区间开始日-平台日后一个开放开始日*/ nvl(qjVdate.OPEN_DATE_END,fp.VDATE) openDateEnd, case when fp.IS_SUS = 'Y' then qjMdate.OPEN_MDATE+1 else fp.MDATE end openmdate,/*区间到期日*/ forule.FIRST_OPEN_DATE AS firstOpenDate, /*首次开放日*/ forule.OPEN_MODE AS openMode, /*开放确认模式*/ forule.CALC_METHOD AS calcMethod, /*推算方法*/ forule.OPEN_CYCLE_UNIT AS openCycleUnit, /*开放确认周期单位*/ forule.OPEN_CYCLE AS openCycle, /*开放确认周期*/ forule.DAY_TYPE AS dayType, /*开放确认日期类型*/ forule.DAY_VALUE AS dayValue, /*开放确认日期值*/ forule.OPEN_DAYS_TYPE AS openDaysType, /*开放天数类型*/ forule.OPEN_DAYS AS openDays, /*开放天数*/ forule.CPRICE_RULE AS cpriceRule, /*净值日取值规则*/ forule.TRADEDAY_RULE AS tradedayRule, /*营业日准则*/ forule.CALC_RULE AS calcRule, /*推算规则*/ forule.HDAY_OPEN_FLAG AS hdayOpenFlag, /*节假日是否开放*/ fpa.DEAL_MODE AS dealMode, /*处理模式*/ fpa.IS_CYCLE AS isCycle, /*是否周期型*/ fpa.CLOSE_DAYS AS closeDays, /*封闭期限*/ fpa.PUR_SPEED AS purSpeed, /*申购确认速度*/ fpa.PUR_SPEED AS purConfDays FROM FIN_PRODUCT fp inner join qjMdate on fp.FINPROD_ID = qjMdate.FINPROD_ID left join qjVdate on qjVdate.CASH_ID = qjMdate.CASH_ID and qjVdate.OPEN_TYPE = qjMdate.OPEN_TYPE
INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpa ON fp.FINPROD_ID = fpa.FINPROD_ID AND fpa.ISSUE_STATUS in ('01','03') INNER JOIN FIN_OPEN_RULE forule ON qjMdate.CASH_ID = forule.CASH_ID AND qjMdate.OPEN_TYPE = forule.OPEN_TYPE WHERE fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 in ('F16','F24') -- AND fp.P_FINPROD_ID IS NULL AND fp.OPERATION_TYPE = '02' and fp.vdate <= to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')/*平台日-跑批日*/ and fp.mdate > TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')/*平台日-跑批日*/

select TT.listN from ( select decode(t1.PROFIT_TYPE,'01',t.OPEN_NDATE,'03',t.OPEN_DATE_END) as listN from FIN_OPEN_PLAN t left join FIN_PRODUCT t1 on t1.FINPROD_ID=t.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_OPEN_RULE t2 on t2.CASH_ID=t.CASH_ID where t1.PROFIT_TYPE in('01','03') and t2.OPEN_MODE !='02' /*非高频开放*/ and t.FINPROD_ID=#{finprodId} )TT order by TT.listN

select DISTINCT t1.cash_id as cashId,t.vdate,t.mdate, t2.F_ACCR_DATE as provisionfirstday,t2.E_ACCR_DATE as eAccrDate from FIN_PRODUCT t left join FIN_CASH_INFO t1 on t1.finprod_id=t.finprod_id and t1.CASH_TYPE_2='C04' and t1.BRANCH = 0 left join FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE t2 on t2.cash_id=t1.cash_id where t.finprod_id=#{finprodId}

/*付息区间开始日*/ with payVdates as( SELECT T.CASH_ID, T.VDATE, T.MDATE, T.CASH_NUM, T.FINPROD_ID, T.RN FROM ( SELECT fcp.CASH_ID, fcp.FINPROD_ID, fcp.VDATE, fcp.MDATE, fcp.CASH_NUM, RANK () OVER(PARTITION BY fci.CASH_ID ORDER BY fcp.VDATE DESC) RN FROM FIN_CASH_INFO fci inner join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fci.FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID inner join FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp on fcp.CASH_ID = fci.CASH_ID WHERE fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F16' AND fci.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1} AND fp.PROFIT_TYPE in ('02','03') AND fp.P_FINPROD_ID IS NULL AND fcp.VDATE <= to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')/*平台日-跑批日*/ /*过滤已付息的计划*/ AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL LEFT JOIN PRD_LAYER_PARAM ON TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID = PRD_LAYER_PARAM.FINPROD_ID WHERE nvl(PRD_LAYER_PARAM.P_FINPROD_ID, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID) = fcp.FINPROD_ID AND fcp.MDATE = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.MDATE AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_CANCEL = 'N' and TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.Trade_Status = '01' AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.PS in ('C7') ) ) T WHERE T.RN = 1 ), /*付息区间结束日*/ payMdates as( SELECT fcp.CASH_ID, fcp.FINPROD_ID, max(fcp.MDATE) mdate FROM FIN_CASH_INFO fci inner join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fci.FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID inner join FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp on fcp.CASH_ID = fci.CASH_ID WHERE fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F16' AND fci.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1} AND fp.PROFIT_TYPE in ('02','03') AND fp.P_FINPROD_ID IS NULL AND fcp.VDATE > to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')/*平台日-跑批日*/ /*过滤已付息的计划*/ AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL LEFT JOIN PRD_LAYER_PARAM ON TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID = PRD_LAYER_PARAM.FINPROD_ID WHERE nvl(PRD_LAYER_PARAM.P_FINPROD_ID, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID) = fcp.FINPROD_ID AND fcp.MDATE = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.MDATE AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_CANCEL = 'N' and TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.Trade_Status = '01' AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.PS in ('C7') ) group by fcp.CASH_ID, fcp.FINPROD_ID ) select '付息计划' planType,/*计划类型*/ fp.FINPROD_ID AS FINPROD_ID,/*金融产品代码*/ fp.PROFIT_TYPE AS profitType,/*收益类型*/ fp.VDATE AS VDATE,/*产品起息日*/ fp.CALENDAR_ID AS calendarId, /*交易日历*/ payVdates.CASH_ID AS cashId, /*现金流代码*/ payVdates.VDATE payVdate,/*付息计划区间开始日-平台日所在的付息开始日*/ payVdates.CASH_NUM cashNum,/*现金流序号*/ nvl(payMdates.mdate, fp.mdate) payMdate,/*付息区间到期日*/ payVdates.MDATE payFPMdate,/*付息计划首次结束日-平台日所在的付息结束日*/ nvl2(fcpr.PAY_CYCLE_VAL,'02',fcpr.PAY_CYCLE) payCycle,/*支付频率:01到期 02周期支付*/ fcpr.PAY_CYCLE_VAL payCycleVal,/*支付频率值*/ nvl2(fcpr.PAY_CYCLE_VAL,fcpr.PAY_CYCLE,null) payCycleUnit,/*付息周期单位*/ fcpr.PAY_TDAY_RULE payTdayRule,/*支付日营业日准则*/ fcpr.END_TDAY_RULE endTdayRule,/*截止日营业日准则*/ fcpr.FIRST_PAY_DATE firstPayDate,/*首次支付日*/ fcpr.CALC_RULE calcRule,/*推算方式*/ fp.LIQUIDATION_DATE winupDate/*清盘日*/ from FIN_PRODUCT fp inner join payVdates on fp.FINPROD_ID = payVdates.FINPROD_ID left join payMdates on fp.FINPROD_ID = payMdates.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE fcpr ON payVdates.CASH_ID = fcpr.CASH_ID AND fp.VDATE = fcpr.EFF_DATE where fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F16' AND fp.PROFIT_TYPE in ('02','03') AND fp.P_FINPROD_ID IS NULL and (fcpr.PAY_CYCLE_VAL is not null or fcpr.PAY_CYCLE = '08') and fp.vdate <= to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')/*平台日-跑批日*/ and fp.mdate > TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')/*平台日-跑批日*/

select t.mdate from ( SELECT decode(ps,'C7',mdate,'C9',trade_date) mdate, finprod_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY finprod_id ORDER BY decode(ps,'C7',mdate,'C9',trade_date) DESC ) ro FROM trd_fin_product_deal_total WHERE ps in ('C7','C9') AND finprod_type2 = 'F16' AND trade_status = '01' AND (is_cancel = 'N' OR is_cancel IS NULL) and finprod_id = #{finprodId} ) t where t.ro = 1
